comment: Independent C-first do.c swallowed carrot -> muse.c mcureblindness(FALSE) caller. Plan to establish actual blindness before engulf, feed carrot inside worm, escape with digging, and inspect restored monster sight. Scout item slots first. Use the runtime debug_mongen option to establish suppression of unrelated random generation in source, rather than assume its config value. Source correction before target action: do.c 840-882 sets could_heal only for a nurse corpse. The carrot was an incorrect proposed target and is retained as setup history. Wish the actual nurse corpse, then create a peaceful purple worm and scout its placement before potion throw. Source reveals a cheaper second engulf setup: zap.c potionhit always hits the swallower when u.uswallow, so blind the worm from inside with the potion instead of provoking camera fear first. Use a partly eaten nurse corpse to reduce encumbrance and leave enough input turns before digestion; engulfer_digests_food tests corpse species regardless of eaten fraction. First force attack the known adjacent peaceful worm and inspect actual engulf state. Actual C force attack engulfed hero at step464; after the first digestion hero has 186 HP. Throw blind potion f northeast while swallowed (guaranteed potionhit against swallower), inspect with stethoscope h, drop actual partly eaten nurse corpse i, inspect again, and escape using digging wand g. Source helper is do.c engulfer_digests_food, and the implemented C blindness helper is muse.c mcureblindness(FALSE).
